title: ticket_triage_input/v1
description: The step input that the host writes to .baltor/step/input.json before launch. Every path is relative to the workspace root.

ticket_path.description: The ticket text, placed in the workspace by the host.

allowed_path_prefixes.description: Where tonight's change may go. A prefix that ends with a slash covers a folder; any other prefix names one file.

unavailable_tonight.description: Things no step can use tonight, in plain words, such as network access or a decision by a person.

test_command_example.description: A command that runs one existing test in this repository, as the program and its arguments, so the first test command can follow the same form.

command.description: The program and its arguments, the program first, as the next step runs them without a shell from the workspace root.
